en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a panoramic view of a historic town nestled by a winding river. Prominently situated atop a hill is a large fortress or castle complex with several towers and large, ornate buildings, including what appears to be a church or cathedral with a tall spire. Dense trees and traditional European houses fill the area surrounding the base of the hill. Smokestacks can be seen in the background, indicating some industrial presence.
